# Release names with hand-reviewed expected fields. Format: see tests/corpus.rs.
# Sources: see SOURCES.md next to this file.
#
# Conventions the expectations follow:
# - title is the series title as written, before the episode marker. A season
#   marker (S2, Season 2, 2nd Season, Second Season) moves to season and leaves
#   the title. A parenthesis inside the title stays in it.
# - Between alternative titles split by " / ", the first one in Latin letters.
# - episode is the number within its kind: SP01 and NCOP2 give 1 and 2.
# - resolution is the vertical line count; 4K is 2160.
# - checksum is the eight-digit CRC32, written in capitals.
# - For a movie marked `Title: The Movie - Subtitle`, the subtitle is the
#   episode title.
# - For a range such as 01-12, episode is the first and last_episode the
#   last; a range, Batch, Complete or a volume makes batch true. A season on
#   its own (S2, Season 2) is not a batch.
# - A dash written as an en dash in the name shows as - in the title.
# - Tag values are the enum names in lowercase: h265, dualaudio, webdl.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# From reference/seanime tests (GPL-3.0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
